text: Front brake pad chaar sau pachaas, labour do sau. <pauses> Kul chhe sau pachaas rupaye. Somvaar shaam tak.
Agar aapko yeh manzoor hai, toh boliye: Haan, theek hai. Kuch galat ho toh bataiye.
Nahi, brake pad saade chaar sau bola tha. Labour do sau hi hai.
Gaadi Mangalvaar subah tak mil jayegi. <slow> Kul ek hazaar do sau rupaye.
